image-animator.mc-image-animator.animate.note: Title of the window that animates a library image, shown while the image is still opening.
Title of the image animator window. {name} is the name of the library image.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.animati.text: Animating needs a newer Magic Card Utils. Update it and try again.
image-animator.mc-image-animator.animati.note: Notice in the image animator when the installed Magic Card Utils is too old to store an animation.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.close.note: Button that closes the image animator window.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.could-n.text: Could not reach Magic Card Utils. Your work is safe.
image-animator.mc-image-animator.could-n.note: Error in the image animator when the image library does not answer or refuses a call.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.count-a.note: Line under the preview in the image animator with the number of animations the image holds.

vars.count: Number of animations of the image.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.opening.note: Status line in the image animator while the image loads from the library.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.save.note: Button in the image animator that saves the image and its animations to the library.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.saved.note: Status line in the image animator after the image was saved to the library.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.saved-t.note: Status line after an uploaded drawing was added to the image library. {name} is the new image name.

vars.name: Name given to the new library image.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.saving.note: Status line in the image animator while the save is running.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.the-sav.text: The saved animation of this image is not valid, so the image cannot be animated here.
image-animator.mc-image-animator.the-sav.note: Error in the image animator when the animation stored with the image fails its checks.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-dr.text: This drawing contains markup that cannot be used.
image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-dr.note: Error in the image animator when the drawing holds markup the card refuses.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-fi.text: This file is not an SVG drawing.
image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-fi.note: Error in the image animator when an uploaded file is not an SVG.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-im.text: This image has no animations yet.
image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-im.note: Line under the preview in the image animator when the image holds no animation.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-im.text: This image is larger than the library accepts.
image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-im.note: Error in the image animator when the image or upload is over the library size limit.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-im.text: This image is not in the library any more.
image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-im.note: Error in the image animator when the library no longer holds the image.

image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-im.text: This image was changed somewhere else. Close this window and open it again.
image-animator.mc-image-animator.this-im.note: Error in the image animator when a save finds the image changed since it was opened.
